prompt:
Create ONE new full-body 2D animation pose asset of Xiaoman for shots S01/S04 of the short film "来电". Use the two attached images as the approved character identity, costume and drawing-style references. The girl is the SAME Xiaoman, not a redesign.

Action and composition: Xiaoman is lying naturally PRONE on her stomach, playing a handheld smartphone in LANDSCAPE orientation. Her body extends horizontally across the image, feet toward screen LEFT and head toward screen RIGHT. BOTH elbows rest on the same implied floor plane in front of her chest and support her raised head/upper chest; both forearms angle upward from those planted elbows to hold the phone comfortably in front of her face. Her gaze is engaged with the phone, with a small concentrated mouth and relaxed focused eyebrows. She is absorbed in the game, not posing for the viewer. This is the calm initial playing pose, NOT a roll-over, collapse, seated pose or chin-in-hands pose.

Her torso and pelvis rest naturally on the implied floor, with a continuous relaxed waist/hip line. Both thighs lead back to the knees on the floor; both knees are bent so the lower legs rise comfortably upward behind her. Ankles and red sandals are relaxed, slightly offset so two lower legs and two feet can be read without duplicating limbs. The bend must occur at the actual knees, not in the middle of the shins. No extreme back arch, no floating abdomen, no broken shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee or ankle. Keep normal child anatomy and normal limb lengths. The yellow dress drapes naturally along the torso and over the hips/upper legs in this everyday resting pose. Do not change the costume.

Identity and clothing: preserve the same round face, dark brown eyes, straight dark-brown fringe, one curved crown tuft, TWO low pigtails with red fluffy pom-pom ties, white rounded Peter Pan collar, yellow short-sleeved dress with white polka dots, and red strapped sandals. In this right-facing view the far pigtail may be partly occluded, but it should not become a different hairstyle. The near anatomical right arm and far left arm connect correctly to their own shoulders. No added jewelry.

Phone and hands are crucial: exactly TWO normal child hands jointly hold ONE modest-size thin dark smartphone, long axis in landscape orientation. Each hand grips one end, with short naturally curved fingers supporting the back/edges and thumbs resting near the screen controls. The phone is angled toward HER EYES, with correct side-view perspective; show its back and thin edge if those are what the camera can see. Do NOT force the screen to face the camera, do not paint a large frontal green rectangle, and do not turn the phone into a tablet. Any small visible screen sliver may be a subdued neutral color with no legible UI or text. Keep the phone a believable rigid thin rectangular object, with hand/phone front-back occlusion correct. No long straight bar fingers, stretched hooked thumbs, fused or extra fingers, extra hands, bent phone, or floating phone. Her elbows remain supported while both hands hold it above the floor.

View: a clear right-facing SIDE view with a mildly elevated camera angle, suitable for compositing onto the floor of the film's room wide shot; a little of the upper surfaces may be seen, but this is not an aerial overhead shot and not an exaggerated low-angle view. Full head and hair tuft, complete phone, both hands and elbows, both knees, both raised lower legs and sandals must fit inside the canvas with safe margins. Wide landscape composition, about 1536x1024 if supported, character spanning most of the width while remaining completely in frame. Do not crop any limb or phone.

Draw ONLY the girl and her phone on a plain uniform light gray background. The scene compositor will add the bamboo mat, room, lights, cast shadows and game image later. Do NOT draw a mat, rug, floor line, floor texture, cast shadow, pillow, bed, furniture, grandmother, lamp, charger cable or any other object. Clean restrained dark outlines, simple flat cel colors and a few natural folds matching the references, neutral flat light, no dramatic baked illumination or screen glow. No labels, captions, panels, collage or border. Preserve native output resolution; one image only.
